rca of the issue: GET /api/staff/me/week-off-requests → 500 Internal Server Error. Root cause: routes/staff_portal.py references db.week_off_requests but database._DB never registered a TenantCollection for it → AttributeError. Fix (applied): added `week_off_requests = TenantCollection(_raw_db.week_off_requests)` alongside leave_requests in database.py._DB. All week-off endpoints now work end-to-end.
